sources.content: # CLAUDE.md for Imbrevant. Imbrevant is an OpenID Connect sign-in server written in Go 1.22. The main binary builds from `cmd/imbrevant` with `make build`, which writes to `bin/imbrevant`. Run unit tests with `make test` and the database tests with `make test-db`, which needs Docker and starts Postgres 16 on port 55432. Config is read from `config/dev.yaml` by default; set `IMB_CONFIG` to point elsewhere. Never log access tokens, refresh tokens or ID tokens, even at debug level.

Security rules. Signing keys rotate every 90 days through `scripts/rotate-keys.sh`; do not edit `keys/` by hand. Access tokens expire after 15 minutes and refresh tokens after 30 days. Any change under `internal/crypto/` needs review from a member of the security group in CODEOWNERS before merge. Use `crypto/rand`, never `math/rand`, for anything secret. Password hashing uses Argon2id with the parameters in `internal/crypto/params.go`. New endpoints must add a test in `internal/http/routes_test.go`. Run `make lint` before every push.

claims.text: Imbrevant signing keys rotate every 90 days.
Imbrevant's database tests start Postgres 16 on port 5432.
Setting IMB_CONFIG makes Imbrevant read a config file other than config/dev.yaml.
Imbrevant access tokens expire after 60 minutes.
Changes under internal/crypto/ in Imbrevant need review from the security group before merge.
